-2-  NC: 2026:KHC-K:988  MFA No. 202651 of 2023 HC-KAR SENIOR CIVIL JUDGE AND MACT-XV, VIJAYAPURA IN M.V.C.NO.888/2021 DATED 17.11.2022 SEEKING FOR ENHANCEMENT AND BE PLEASED TO ALLOW THE CLAIM PETITION BY GRANTING THE RELIEF AS PRAYED FAR BY THE APPELLANT.
 THIS APPEAL COMING ON FOR ADMISSION, THIS DAY,
JUDGMENT WAS DELIVERED THEREIN AS UNDER:
CORAM: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE E.S.INDIRESH  ORAL JUDGMENT Heard the learned counsel appearing for the parties.
2.

This appeal is arising out of the judgment and award dated 17.11.2022 in AVC No.888/2021, on the file of the Motor Accident Claims Tribunal No.XV at Vijayapura (hereinafter referred to as 'Tribunal'), awarding compensation.

entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 3. Having taken note of the submission made by the learned counsel appearing for the parties, there is no dispute as to the fact that, the claimant has sustained grievous injuries on account of the accident occurred on 27.02.2020.

By looking into the injuries sustained by the claimant as per the wound certificate at Ex.P7 and taking NC: 2026:KHC-K:988 HC-KAR into account the evidence of PW.2 - treating doctor in the right prospective, I am of the view that, the Tribunal ought to have taken the disability at 15% to the whole body,.

The Tribunal has rightly taken the income of the claimant at Rs.14,250/- per month and by applying the appropriate multiplier of 17, the compensation towards loss of future earning capacity would be Rs.4,36,050/-
(Rs.14,250x12x17x15%).
4. Taking into consideration the disability certificate produced at Ex.15 and the evidence of PW.2,
the award of compensation by the Tribunal is reassessed as follows:
 Heads Amount Pain and suffering Rs.50,000/-
Loss of earnings during laid up Rs.42,750/- period (Rs.14,250x3) Loss of amenities Rs.10,000/-

2

Loss of future of earnings Rs.4,36,050/- Towards food and nourishment Rs.20,000/- Towards attendant charges Rs.20,000/- Medical expenses Rs.5,76,600/-
Total Rs.11,55,400/-
Less: awarded by Tribunal Rs.8,01,400/-
Enhancement Rs.3,54,000/-
 NC: 2026:KHC-K:988 HC-KAR
Thus, the clamant is entitled for enhanced compensation of Rs.3,54,000/- with interest at the rate of 6% per annum.

5. In the result, I pass the following:
ORDER I.
The appeal is allowed in part.
II. The appellant/claimant is entitled for enhanced compensation of Rs.3,54,000/- with interest at the rate of 6% per annum from the date of petition till the date of realization.
III. Respondent No.2 - Insurance Company is directed to deposit the compensation amount within six weeks from the date of receipt of certified copy of this judgment.
